headline: Brazil FGTS Approves R$ 144.5 Billion Housing Budget for 2027
summary: Brazil's FGTS Board of Trustees approved a R$ 144.5 billion housing budget for 2027, maintaining 2026 funding levels for the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program and subsidized financing.
why: FGTS funding is the cornerstone of Brazil's low-income housing market, directly fueling demand for Brazilian homebuilders and construction materials.

impacts.name: Brazilian Homebuilders
impacts.why: Guaranteed R$ 144.5 billion in funding for Minha Casa, Minha Vida secures liquidity and order backlogs for low-income builders.
